reviewer_notes: The only National Board material in the contract is Article Seven, Section C on PDF page 14 (printed footer 13): the parties 'shall create a joint study committee to evaluate a program to enable teachers to become credentialed by the National Board for Professional Teaching Standards' with recommendations due May 31, 2008 — no stipend, differential, or salary-schedule credit anywhere (searched 'National Board certification stipend', 'certification differential additional compensation', 'credentialed teaching standards payment', 'master teacher advanced certification bonus', plus a raw scan for 'National Board'/'NBPTS'/'certif' across all 54 pages; Appendix B salary schedules carry only degree lanes, a BA-step-1 hiring bonus, and role add-ons). B's not_discussed is therefore wrong because the topic is expressly addressed on page 14. A quotes the governing passage verbatim but the passage does not explicitly state that extra pay is absent or prohibited, so under the rubric 'no' overstates it (discussed_unclear fits a study-committee-only provision), and A's page 13 is the printed footer rather than PDF page 14, off by one.
